نتزايد (form VI)
# نَتَزَايَدُ (natazāyadu) /na.ta.zaː.ja.du/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَزَايَدَ (tazāyada)
# نَتَزَايَدَ (natazāyada) /na.ta.zaː.ja.da/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَزَايَدَ (tazāyada)
# نَتَزَايَدْ (natazāyad) /na.ta.zaː.jad/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَزَايَدَ (tazāyada)
